# Root systems and simple Lie algebras {#sec-root-systems}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Work with roots, the Cartan matrix and Dynkin diagrams of every simple Lie algebra.
- Use the Weyl group, the Coxeter element, the Coxeter number and the exponents.
- Construct weights and the fundamental representations.
- Compute the Perron–Frobenius eigenvector of a Cartan matrix and see why it will reappear as a mass spectrum.
:::

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple" title="To be written"}
Sources to draw on: Humphreys, *Introduction to Lie Algebras and Representation Theory*; Fuchs–Schweigert, *Symmetries, Lie Algebras and Representations*; Kostant 1959.
:::
